Your doubles rating can swing daily because UTR's algorithm recalibrates every 24 hours and adjusts the weights of your existing matches — even without new results posted. especially when you have fewer matches in your record, as the system is still calibrating your skill level. As you accumulate more doubles matches, your rating typically becomes more stable.

The 100% confidence you're seeing reflects how certain the system is about your current rating based on your match history, but that doesn't prevent the rating number itself from fluctuating as the algorithm recalibrates nightly.

For a personalized breakdown of what's driving these swings in your specific case — which matches are being weighted, how recent results are affecting your rating, and what you can do about it — **Rally** is your best resource.
